children: Robot Consulting received a Nasdaq determination to delist its ADSs under Rules 5101 and IM-5101-4 and has appealed to a Hearings Panel. The suspension and Form 25-NSE filing are stayed pending review; an existing trading halt remains.
Nasdaq moved to delist LAWR ADSs
Delisting risks loss of Nasdaq listing, impairing liquidity and investor access.
Triggers a stay of suspension/Form 25-NSE pending panel review.
Prevents immediate trading; limits exit/entry until lifted.
Signals concerns over liquidity/market integrity; may deter investors.
Limits reputational/legal damage; issue tied to trading activity, not ops.

This is a regulatory setback centered on market integrity, not operations, and could remove the stock from Nasdaq. A successful appeal or a lift of the trading halt would be needed to restore liquidity; an adverse panel decision would make delisting likely.
